transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you here? How can I help you?
I guess… I got scared because I keep thinking it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself or anything, but… it’s been on my mind.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you cared about?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to look forward to doing my watercolors, and going to dance class, walking with the ladies… but lately I just leave everything sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself care.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much, or blaming yourself for things you wouldn’t normally feel guilty about?
Yes… I do. Mostly with my aunt. If I’m tired or I get annoyed, I start thinking I’m a bad woman… like I should be more grateful. Like I’m bringing shame on the family.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, even when you haven’t done anything physically demanding?
Yeah… I feel worn out a lot. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, just making breakfast or carrying laundry feels like too much sometimes.
Have you found it harder to focus on things, like following a conversation or making decisions, even simple ones?
I’m not sure… maybe a little, but I haven’t really noticed that so much. I can usually follow along, I think. Decisions… I don’t know, I just don’t like making them lately.
Have you found that it's harder to think clearly or concentrate on tasks, like reading or watching a show, even if it's something you normally enjoy?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed it that clearly. Sometimes I don’t stay with things long, but I can’t say if it’s my concentration or just… not feeling like it.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually energetic or needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No… I don’t think so. I can’t remember feeling like that, not really.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
I haven’t really kept track. I don’t think it’s changed much… maybe some days I don’t feel like eating, but I’m not sure.
Has this feeling of being worn out or lacking energy been happening nearly every day, or does it come and go?
It’s… most days, I guess. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I still feel worn out. Little things, like making breakfast or carrying laundry, feel like too much sometimes.
Have you found it difficult to focus on things, like following a conversation or making decisions, even simple ones?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I don’t really pay much attention to it. Decisions can feel… harder than they should, I guess, but I’m not sure.

Looking back over the past few weeks, do you think there has been a change in your appetite—even if it was subtle—or have you noticed any weight loss or gain that isn’t because of dieting or exercise?
I’m not really sure. My clothes seem about the same, I think. Some days I don’t eat much, but I haven’t noticed any real weight change.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep—like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?
I don’t really know. I sleep… some, I guess. I haven’t been keeping track of it. Nothing I can say for sure.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or have others commented that you seem slowed down? Or, on the other hand, have you felt restless or fidgety, unable to sit still?
I guess… slower, maybe. My husband says I move like everything takes more effort now. Even at the market, I’ll just stand there too long before I pick up what I came for.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like your watercolors or dance class—or is there still some part of you that cares, even if it’s hard to act on it?

I guess… it feels like I don’t care much anymore. I used to look forward to my watercolors and dance class, walking with the ladies… but lately I just leave the stuff sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself want to do it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been going on for weeks, months, or longer?
About… four months, I think. Since my aunt came to live with us. It’s hard to say exactly, but around then.
Have you had episodes like this before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for such a long period?
I don’t know… not like this, I don’t think. I’ve had low times before, but this feels like it’s been going on longer.

latest_inference.note: The patient has described a persistent low mood, anhedonia, fatigue, psychomotor slowing, feelings of guilt/worthlessness, and passive death wishes without suicidal intent. Symptoms have been present for about four months without a prior similar episode, and there is no history of manic or hypomanic symptoms. This supports a major depressive episode, and given the duration and absence of prior episodes, it aligns with F32.2 (Severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms) or F33.2 (Recurrent depressive disorder, current episode severe without psychotic symptoms), depending on history of prior episodes, which remains unclear.
